name: git-github-mcp
description: FastMCP 3.1+ portmanteau server: git_ops (43) + github_ops (58) = 101 actions, git_github_status/help, two sampling agentic workflows, 7 prompts, 8 resources (incl. skills), optional FastAPI web bridge.

tools.name: git_ops
tools.description: Local Git — 43 actions: init, clone, status, add, commit, push, pull, fetch, log, diff, show, blame, branches, rebase, remotes, stash, tags, reset, revert, cherry_pick, clean, submodule_*, bisect_*, worktree_*

tools.name: github_ops
tools.description: GitHub via gh CLI — 58 actions: repos (incl. show_repo), issues, PRs, releases, Actions workflows, labels, secrets, collaborators, search (repos, topic, issues, code, code_find_repos), Projects, Packages, Gitingest (gitingest_link/convert_url/help), auth_status, gist_list

tools.name: git_github_status
tools.description: System status: git and gh CLI availability, versions, auth state

tools.name: git_github_help
tools.description: Contextual help for operations (level: basic/intermediate/advanced; topic: git_ops|github_ops)

tools.name: git_agentic_workflow
tools.description: Sampling: plan and execute multi-step git_ops + github_ops from natural language (requires MCP sampling)

tools.name: git_github_search_workflow
tools.description: Sampling: GitHub discovery/search only — planned github_ops chain (requires MCP sampling)

prompts.name: git_commit_message
prompts.description: Generate a conventional commit message from a staged diff

prompts.name: git_release_notes
prompts.description: Generate release notes from a commit log

prompts.name: git_pr_description
prompts.description: Generate a pull request description from branch and commits

prompts.name: git_review_diff
prompts.description: Code review prompt for a git diff

prompts.name: github_issue_template
prompts.description: Generate a GitHub issue body (types: bug, feature, docs, question)

prompts.name: github_debug_workflow
prompts.description: Debug a failing GitHub Actions workflow from error output

prompts.name: git_github_explain_concept
prompts.description: Teach a Git/GitHub concept with examples (e.g. gitingest, agentic-workflows)

resources.description: Current git status of the working directory
Recent commit log of the working directory
Git status for a specific repo path
Commit log for a specific repo path
Open issues for a GitHub repository
Open pull requests for a GitHub repository
Focused lecture notes (e.g. rebase, gitingest, agentic-workflows)

dependencies: gh CLI (gh auth login required for github_ops)
